tldr: 台股10月開門紅，大漲413點（+0.86%）收48,353.49點、改寫收盤新高，台積電與權值科技股領軍衝鋒。
三大法人合計買超292.52億元，外資連2買、加碼219億元，資金動能回流。
被動元件與載板族群受AI伺服器需求帶動噴出，外資估2026全球半導體銷售額上看1兆美元。
金管會監理不鬆手，裁罰金額走升、嚴審ETF募集；高資產財富規模估2029年上看59兆元。
台灣9月製造業PMI續緊縮、但全年出口估成長逾22%；美國政府10月1日關門，華爾街卻因ADP爆冷、升高降息預期而創新高。

items.title_zh: 台股10月開門紅 狂飆413點創收盤新高
items.title_en: TAIEX storms to record close in October opener, up 413 points
items.summary_zh: 加權指數10月1日開季走強，終場大漲413.36點、漲幅0.86%，收在48,353.49點、再創收盤歷史新高，強勢站回48K大關。台積電上漲30元（+1.21%）收2,510元，單一個股貢獻大盤約239點；載板三雄與被動元件族群同步走揚，帶動盤面全面擴散，多頭氣勢延續。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index opened the fourth quarter on a strong note, surging 413.36 points (+0.86%) on Oct 1 to close at a record 48,353.49, reclaiming the 48,000 level with authority. TSMC rose NT$30 (+1.21%) to NT$2,510 and alone contributed roughly 239 index points, while substrate and passive-component names joined the rally to broaden the advance.

items.title_zh: 三大法人買超292.5億 外資連2買回補動能
items.title_en: Institutions pile in: NT$29.25bn net buy as foreign money returns
items.summary_zh: 10月1日買盤全面擴張，三大法人合計買超292.52億元，外資連續第2個交易日買超、單日加碼219.37億元。外資偏好緯創、聯電、國巨等AI供應鏈與被動元件要角，同時大砍面板股群創約9.3萬張，顯示資金明顯向AI與零組件主流族群輪動，盤面結構轉趨積極。
items.summary_en: Buying was broad on Oct 1, with the three major institutional investors net-buying NT$29.25 billion and foreign investors adding NT$21.9 billion for a second consecutive session. Foreign favorites included Wistron, UMC and Yageo, while they trimmed panel maker Innolux by some 93,000 lots, signaling a clear rotation toward AI-supply-chain and passive-component leaders.

items.title_zh: 被動元件升級大潮 AI伺服器需求點火
items.title_en: Passive-component super-cycle gathers pace on AI-server demand
items.summary_zh: 被動元件族群迎來新一波升級潮，國巨領軍多檔個股亮燈漲停，AI伺服器建置大幅拉高零組件規格門檻。單台AI伺服器搭載的積層陶瓷電容（MLCC）高達1萬至4萬顆、約為一般伺服器的十倍，支撐被動元件結構性需求，法人看好此超級循環動能可望延續至2027年。
items.summary_en: A fresh upgrade wave is lifting Taiwan's passive-component sector, with Yageo leading a clutch of names to limit-up as AI-server buildouts drive sharply higher component specs. Each AI server can carry 10,000 to 40,000 multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) — roughly ten times a standard server — underpinning a structural demand story that analysts expect to extend through 2027.

items.title_zh: 外資估2026全球半導體銷售額上看1兆美元
items.title_en: Foreign brokers see 2026 global chip sales nearing US$1 trillion
items.summary_zh: 外資研究機構預估，2026年全球半導體營收將邁向1兆美元大關、年增約30%，主要動能來自生成式AI、大型語言模型（LLM）與高速運算需求。大摩點名六家台廠受惠，其中台積電以N3／N2先進製程與CoWoS封裝產能鞏固領先地位，供應鏈同步受惠於這波AI驅動的產能爭奪戰。
items.summary_en: Foreign research houses forecast global semiconductor revenue climbing toward the US$1 trillion milestone in 2026, with growth of around 30% powered by generative AI, large language models and high-performance computing demand. Morgan Stanley flagged six Taiwanese beneficiaries, with TSMC consolidating its lead via N3/N2 advanced nodes and CoWoS packaging capacity.

items.title_zh: 金管會前8月裁罰金融三業1.34億 年增4%
items.title_en: FSC fines on financial trio rise, topping NT$134m in first eight months
items.summary_zh: 金管會監理力度不減，今年前8月對銀行、證券、保險三業合計開罰1億3,428萬元，年增約4%。裁罰金額穩步走升，凸顯主管機關對金融業內控與法令遵循的要求趨嚴；市場解讀，強化風控與治理已成金融機構營運的核心課題，相關缺失恐面臨更高違規成本。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission kept up its enforcement push, with penalties on the banking, securities and insurance sectors reaching NT$134.28 million in the first eight months of the year, up about 4% year-on-year. The steady rise in fines underscores the regulator's tightening stance on internal controls and compliance across the financial industry.

items.title_zh: ETF募集之亂 金管會將嚴審新產品
items.title_en: FSC to tighten scrutiny of ETF marketing amid fundraising frenzy
items.summary_zh: 隨著ETF募集熱潮升溫，金管會釋出訊號，對出現不當勸誘或銷售爭議的業者，將從嚴審查其新產品申請，以遏止過度行銷亂象。此舉反映在ETF規模快速膨脹、通路激烈競爭認購的背景下，主管機關對投資人保護的重視升高，業者募集與銷售行為將受更嚴格檢視。
items.summary_en: With ETF fundraising heating up, the FSC signaled it will more strictly review new product applications where improper solicitation or mis-selling is found, aiming to curb aggressive marketing practices. The move reflects regulators' growing focus on investor protection as ETF assets swell and distribution channels compete intensely for subscriptions.

items.title_zh: 台灣高資產財富規模估2029年上看59兆元
items.title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth seen reaching NT$59 trillion by 2029
items.summary_zh: 財富管理報告預估，台灣高資產個人財富規模將以年均約10%速度成長，至2029年達新台幣59兆元；高資產客群人數由2025年的12.3萬人增至2029年的15.5萬人，其中10億級超高資產客群上看約1.1萬人。數據顯示私人銀行、信託與跨境資產配置需求將持續擴張，成為銀行財管業務兵家必爭之地。
items.summary_en: A wealth-management outlook projects Taiwan's high-net-worth personal wealth growing at roughly 10% annually to NT$59 trillion by 2029, with the HNW population rising from 123,000 in 2025 to 155,000, and the ultra-rich (NT$1bn-plus) cohort expanding to around 11,000. The findings point to sustained demand for private banking, trust and cross-border allocation services.

items.title_zh: 跨境配置成常態 家族辦公室成新顯學
items.title_en: Cross-border allocation and family offices become the new normal
items.summary_zh: 全台資產破億人數達12.3萬，其中逾七成已布局跨境資產、逾四成加碼美國、新加坡、日本資產，在地緣政治與總經不確定下，資產配置版圖持續重整。家族治理與家族辦公室服務逐步由概念走向治理中樞，帶動銀行與信託業者深化傳承規劃與海外顧問服務，搶攻高資產客戶長期資金。
items.summary_en: Over 70% of Taiwan's wealthy now hold cross-border assets, with more than 40% increasing exposure to the US, Singapore and Japan, as geopolitical and macro uncertainty reshape allocation. Family governance and family-office services are moving from concept to a central pillar of wealth planning, pushing banks and trust providers to deepen succession and offshore advisory offerings.

items.title_zh: 2026年遺產稅免稅額與扣除額維持不變
items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax exemption and deductions stay put
items.summary_zh: 2026年（民國115年）發生的繼承案件，遺產稅免稅額維持新台幣1,333萬元，直系血親卑親屬扣除額為每人56萬元。相關門檻維持不變，為今年度的遺產規劃提供穩定基準；在遺贈稅制其他環節（如死亡前2年贈與改由受贈人按比例負擔）正進行調整之際，免稅額與扣除額的穩定有助家庭預作稅務安排。
items.summary_en: For inheritance cases arising in 2026, Taiwan's estate-tax exemption remains NT$13.33 million, with the deduction for lineal descendants set at NT$560,000 per person. The unchanged thresholds give estate planners a stable baseline for the year, even as other parts of the estate-and-gift tax regime are being reworked to shift certain tax burdens onto gift recipients.

items.title_zh: 財政部研擬遺贈稅後續稽徵子法規
items.title_en: MOF drafts follow-up rules for revised gift-tax collection
items.summary_zh: 配合立法院三讀通過劃一「死亡前2年內贈與特定親屬財產」課稅方式的修法，財政部正研擬修正遺產及贈與稅法施行細則等子法規，並同步修訂相關申報書表與線上申辦系統。前置作業旨在讓「受贈人按比例負擔」的新原則上路後能順利稽徵，減少繼承人替他人受贈財產承擔稅負的爭議。
items.summary_en: Following the legislature's amendment unifying how property gifted within two years of death is taxed, the Ministry of Finance is drafting revisions to the enforcement rules of the Estate and Gift Tax Act, together with updated filing forms and online filing systems. The groundwork aims to let the new "recipient bears the tax" principle be administered smoothly once it takes effect.

items.title_zh: 台灣9月製造業PMI連4月緊縮
items.title_en: Taiwan's September manufacturing PMI stays in contraction
items.summary_zh: 台灣9月製造業採購經理人指數（PMI）連續第4個月緊縮，中華經濟研究院指出傳統產業表現持續偏弱。數據反映在AI相關需求支撐科技供應鏈之際，製造業整體景氣信心仍偏保守，傳產與科技表現分歧；市場關注第4季內外需能否回溫，以及出口動能能否擴散至非AI族群，帶動景氣全面回升。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's manufacturing PMI remained in contraction for a fourth straight month in September, with research institute CIER noting that traditional industries continue to underperform. The reading reflects cautious sentiment among manufacturers even as AI-related demand props up parts of the tech supply chain, pointing to an uneven recovery across sectors heading into the fourth quarter.

items.title_zh: 出口暢旺 全年成長率估逾22%
items.title_en: Exports run hot as full-year growth seen above 22%
items.summary_zh: 相對於製造業信心偏保守，機構預估台灣2026年全年出口年成長率約達22.2%，形容經濟正處於高檔熱絡狀態，主要動能來自AI相關需求。出口暢旺與製造業景氣偏弱形成對比，凸顯這波上行循環高度集中於AI與高速運算供應鏈；若動能能擴散至傳產與內需，景氣基礎將更為穩固。
items.summary_en: Against the cautious manufacturing backdrop, institutional forecasts peg Taiwan's full-year 2026 export growth at around 22.2%, describing the economy as running at a high, buoyant level on AI-driven demand. The divergence between red-hot exports and softer manufacturing sentiment underscores how concentrated the current upcycle is in AI and high-performance computing supply chains.

items.title_zh: 美國政府關門「7年來首見」台媒聚焦
items.title_en: US government shutdown, the first in about seven years, draws Taiwan coverage
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導，美國國會對撥款法案無共識，聯邦政府於10月1日關門，為近7年來首見。國會預算處（CBO）估計約75萬名聯邦員工面臨休假，每日人事成本約4億美元，政府關門亦導致重要經濟數據發布中斷。不過分析師從過往經驗研判，美元匯率恐進一步走弱，但對股市的負面衝擊相對有限，AI投資題材仍支撐市場氣氛。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported that the US federal government shut down on Oct 1 after Congress failed to agree on funding — the first shutdown in roughly seven years. The CBO estimates some 750,000 federal workers face furloughs at a daily personnel cost of about US$400 million, and the lapse delays key economic data releases, though analysts expect the market impact to stay relatively limited.

items.title_zh: 小非農ADP爆冷 降息機率攀升、道瓊標普創新高
items.title_en: Weak ADP lifts US rate-cut odds; Dow and S&P hit records
items.summary_zh: 中文財經盤後報導指出，美國9月ADP小非農數據爆冷，推升市場對聯準會降息的預期，帶動道瓊與標普500指數創新高。由於政府關門使官方非農就業報告延後，投資人改以民間數據為依據；在AI題材支撐下，市場風險偏好未因華府財政僵局而退卻，續抱科技與成長股。
items.summary_en: Chinese-language market wraps noted that a cold September ADP private-payrolls print pushed up expectations for a Federal Reserve rate cut, helping the Dow and S&P 500 set new records. With the shutdown delaying the official jobs report, investors leaned on private data, keeping the AI-fueled risk-on tone intact despite the fiscal standoff in Washington.

items.title_zh: 美股創新高 華爾街無視政府關門（2026-10-01）
items.title_en: US stocks notch records as Wall Street shrugs off the shutdown (2026-10-01)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街10月1日走高，道瓊與標普500指數改寫新高，交易員大致無視聯邦政府關門，並加碼押注聯準會降息。市場研判財政僵局可能為時不長，加上勞動市場轉弱強化寬鬆政策的理由，風險偏好維持高檔，資金續抱科技與成長股。
items.summary_en: Wall Street pushed higher on Oct 1, with the Dow and S&P 500 setting fresh records as traders largely looked past the federal government shutdown and ramped up bets on Federal Reserve rate cuts. Investors wagered that the fiscal standoff would be short-lived and that a softening labor market strengthens the case for easier policy.

items.title_zh: 美國聯邦政府因撥款中斷而關門（2026-10-01）
items.title_en: US federal government shuts down as funding lapses (2026-10-01)
items.summary_zh: 美國聯邦政府10月1日開始關門，國會未能在新會計年度期限前通過撥款法案，觸發聯邦員工休假與機關運作部分停擺。開盤股市漲跌互見，市場評估政治僵局的後續發展，聚焦關門將持續多久、哪些經濟報告會延後發布，以及對聯準會決策參考數據的影響。
items.summary_en: The US federal government began shutting down on Oct 1 after Congress failed to pass funding legislation before the fiscal-year deadline, triggering furloughs and a partial halt to agency operations. Trading opened mixed as markets weighed the political impasse, with attention on how long the shutdown might last and which economic reports would be delayed.

items.title_zh: ADP：美國9月民間就業增9萬 優於預期（2026-10-01）
items.title_en: ADP shows US private payrolls up 90,000 in September, beating estimates (2026-10-01)
items.summary_zh: 美國9月民間聘僱回溫，ADP報告顯示民間就業人數增加9萬人，高於市場約6.8萬人的預期，8月數據則下修至3.6萬人；其中服務業新增5.9萬個職位、商品生產部門增3.1萬個。由於政府關門使官方非農就業報告延後發布，ADP數據在研判勞動市場動向上的參考分量升高。
items.summary_en: Private-sector hiring picked up in September, with ADP reporting payrolls rose 90,000, above the roughly 68,000 consensus, while August was revised down to 36,000. Services added 59,000 jobs and goods-producing industries 31,000. With the shutdown delaying the official nonfarm report, the ADP data took on added weight for gauging the labor market.

items.title_zh: 公債殖利率走升 壓抑大盤整體漲幅（2026-10-01）
items.title_en: Rising Treasury yields keep broader gains in check (2026-10-01)
items.summary_zh: 儘管降息預期支撐股市，10月1日美國公債殖利率走升，壓抑指數漲幅，部分盤面變動有限。投資人在聯準會可能寬鬆的樂觀情緒與殖利率走高的拉力之間取得平衡，並密切關注政府關門造成的數據空窗，將如何影響聯準會下一步決策。
items.summary_en: Even as rate-cut hopes supported equities, climbing US government bond yields capped the advance on Oct 1, leaving parts of the market little changed. Investors balanced optimism over potential Fed easing against the pull of higher yields, keeping an eye on how the shutdown-driven data gaps might shape the Fed's next move.
